verdict.rationale: Vapi documents three agent-friendly surfaces that each cover the full lifecycle. The official CLI says it can 'manage assistants, phone numbers, and calls from your terminal'. The official MCP server exposes the Vapi APIs as tools so any MCP-compatible agent can manage assistants, phone numbers, and calls. The SDK quickstart shows creating an assistant in code. An llms.txt with agent instructions supports AI-native use. Missing for 10: an explicit API/CLI walkthrough of buying or attaching a number and placing an outbound call (the phone quickstart's steps are dashboard-driven), API-based voice ID discovery (docs point to the dashboard Voice Library), and independent hands-on corroboration of a dashboard-free end-to-end flow.
